planning_run.algorithm_change: Square mask dilation matches square wire footprint; one extra planning cell.
planning_run.mask_before:
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt
    occupied = occupied.reshape(X.shape)
    # Extra grid diagonal allowance makes diagonal cell corners conservative.
    free = distance_transform_edt(~occupied)*step > width/2+step/math.sqrt(2)
planning_run.mask_after:
from scipy.ndimage import maximum_filter
    occupied = occupied.reshape(X.shape)
    # Axis-aligned square corridors need square dilation, including their
    # corners. One extra grid step conservatively bounds sampled cell edges.
    radius = math.ceil(width/(2*step)+1)
    free = maximum_filter(occupied.astype(cad.np.uint8), size=2*radius+1,
                          mode='constant', cval=1)==0
